items.name: SteadyStateBVAR
items.description: Provides estimation of Bayesian vector autoregression (BVAR) models with steady-state priors via 'Stan', along with functions for unconditional and conditional forecasting, as well as impulse response analysis. For details on the steady-state BVAR model see Villani (2009) <doi:10.1002/jae.1065>.
